extras.note: Thank you for using Embeddium Extras! By default, all the extras features are disabled, you can follow your preference and enable them in the video setting.

extras.clear_skies.tooltip: Removes the banding at the horizon of Vanilla Minecraft
extras.zoom.max_zoom_scale.tooltip: Max zoom scale is not configurable here. Please check config/embeddiumextras-client.toml
extras.hide_jei_items.tooltip: Stop rendering the items in Just Enough Items GUI unless you are searching. Do note that the items are still clickable though they stop rendering.
extras.dist.entity.dist_sqr: Max Renderable Entity Horizontal Distance From Player
extras.dist.entity.height: Max Renderable Entity Vertical Height From Player
extras.dist.tile.dist_sqr: Max Renderable Tile Entity Horizontal Distance From Player
extras.dist.tile.height: Max Renderable Entity Vertical Height From Player
extras.fast_chest.tooltip: Remove chests' dynamic models (aka BlockEntityRenderer) and making them render as static chunk geometry, like most normal blocks. This means they will lose their lid opening animation.
extras.fast_chest.note.enable: You've turned on Fast Chest feature, don't forget validating the EmbeddiumExtrasFastChestResourcepack in your resourcepacks
extras.fast_chest.note.disable: You've turned off Fast Chest feature, don't forget invalidating the EmbeddiumExtrasFastChestResourcepack in your resourcepacks
extras.video_tape.tooltip: If enabled, Embeddium Extras will try to remove out-dated resources every second through a range of means to prevent potential memory leak.
extras.gl_error: Mute Potential GL Error On Keybinds
extras.gl_error.tooltip: There was never a real error going on here - not the kind you should have to worry about and definitely not the kind that should pollute logs constantly.
extras.fade_in_chunks.time.tooltip: Controls how fast chunks fade in. No performance hit, higher value will make it quicker. 30 will disable this feature.
